phase: v8 Phase 8: point-in-time historical universe and research correctness - an append-only history of every production scan on the v8-history branch (v8/history.py, v8.history/1; written by the Scan workflow after the snapshot, never force-pushed, HISTORY_CAPTURE_DEGRADED on failure), a research-only point-in-time view (v8/pit.py), time-varying slippage and observed funding for research (tools/research/pit_cost.py, pit_sim.py, pit_research.py, a separate artifact), the append-only shadow experiment ledger (v8/shadow_ledger.py, research/shadow-ledger/) and the audit snapshot's history section (v8.audit/6, v8-phase8.0). Audit and research only: no legacy output changes

base.note: production main after the Phase 7 merge (PR #18); its fixture golden is the Phase 7 branch golden

rules.NO_LEGACY_DELTA: Phase 8 adds history capture, research-only modules and a research artifact. No engine imports v8.history, v8.pit or v8.shadow_ledger (the snapshot step writes the history after every engine ran). The universe, every identity state (v8.identity/4 and its config hash unchanged), discovery (v8.discovery/1), every strategy, threshold, gate, stop, target, sizing, ranking, Top-N, the legacy research files (quant_research.json, picks_research.json) and every published legacy file are byte-identical to the base.

not_allowed: any BASE -> HEAD difference at all in the legacy outputs, the universe, the DEX status, the notes, the identity states or the engines' decisions: Phase 8 changes the audit snapshot under data/v8/ (its history section) only.
